rows.grounds: compound hero-rise in nominative singular masculine

items.question: What items are listed alongside garden water sports and honey-drinking festivals as being proclaimed in the puranas?
premises: The list includes mantra gambling measures hero-rise.
items.inference: The verse enumerates additional puranic topics beyond the preceding festivities.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic case of dyūta and nāyakābhyudayaḥ in the list is not fully resolved.
items.plain_english: Mantra, gambling, measures, the rise of heroes, and so on are proclaimed in the puranas.
